svg.text: SCALE 1:25 · SEEN FROM THE ROOM · STUDY WALL ON THE LEFT · OPTION C
5792 OVERALL · STUDY WALL TO DOOR 4420 (ABOUT 14 FT 6 IN) — CONFIRM ON SITE
CUT AT 1000 · SCALE 1:25 · ROOM BELOW, WALL ABOVE
Option C: 5 equal panels, lamps in 1, 3 and 5.
One narrow panel on the 2 ft wall past the door.
Moulding, rail and skirting painted the wall colour.
Dado rail on the 610 line — level with the study
counter top, so the line runs on round the room.
Short and tall panels share the same centres.
Lengths are estimates — set out from site measure,
keeping the stiles 150 and the panels equal.
BRASS, FABRIC SHADES · CENTRED IN PANEL
